meanings.note: Successfully connect by telephone. Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'звониться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get through (by phone)', paired with 'дозваниваться'.

examples.text: Я не могу дозвониться до своей жены.
examples.trans: I cannot get through to my wife.
At home I can't reach him.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.

meanings.en: cruel, harsh, ruthless (short form: жесток / жестока / жестоки)

meanings.note: + с + instrumental. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'знакомиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to meet, to get acquainted', paired with 'знакомиться'.

examples.trans: She was the one who met me! She circled around me like a shark.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
